advancement.cardboarded_conveynience.lik: Ride upon a chain conveyor as doth any other parcel
_comment.cardboarded_conveynience.nermal: Nermal as in the Garfield character often mailed away in boxes. Pun on 'normal'. Translators: try making a pun with your localized name ;)
advancement.cardboarded_conveynience.ner: Be thou delivered to a Frogport by the grace of a nametag
cardboarded_conveynience.ponder.cardboar: Don thou full cardboard armour whilst riding a chain conveyor...
...to feign the semblance of a parcel!
cardboarded_conveynience.ponder.belt_tun: A guised player upon a belt may pass through tunnels...
Andesite tunnels likewise suffer crawling players to pass...
Brass tunnels may sift what passeth through...
...yet thou mayst deceive them by presenting the rightful item.
A wrench filter shall not suffer a cardboard parcel to pass...
...thus thy parcel's guise availeth thee not.
But when the filter doth favour parcels...
...a parcel's guise shall match - thou passest freely through!
When the filter matcheth a piece of armour thou wearest...
...such as the helm upon thy brow, so thou art admitted!
When thou dost bear the matching item in either hand...
Howbeit... when guised as a parcel...
cardboarded_conveynience.ponder.chute_te: Sneak thou upon a chute in full cardboard armour...
...to fall anon unto the bottom of the stack!
Diagonal chutes serve also — enter this one...
...and thou shalt arrive at the selfsame place.
A smart chute with the wrong filter shall not convey thee...
...thou art cast out at the threshold.
With a parcel filter, thou art dropped as any true parcel!
Seeing naught may pass through a locked smart chute...
cardboarded_conveynience.ponder.frogport: Most oft, players ride chain conveyors with no mind to frogports...
...and at junctions the path followeth the way thou dost face.
Whilst guised as a parcel, a nametag in thy offhand guideth thee of itself...
...unto the matching Frogport, wheresoever upon the network.
Nametag routing admitteth wildcards by means of *...
...any matching Frogport becometh a fit destination.
